##### Project general facts

Fahid Beach Terraces by Aldar is a beachfront residential collection of six towers designed by the internationally acclaimed architect Koichi Takada. Flowing forms, extensive glazing and gently curving balconies inspired by tidal imprints mirror the rhythm of the shoreline. Each tower rises above a ground floor and a podium level to ten residential floors, offering one-, two-, three- and four-bedroom apartments, with selected layouts including a maid's room, together with five-bedroom penthouses.

Amenities are planned around wellness and the sea. The clubhouse, elevated above the shoreline, features a gymnasium with waterfront views, a workout studio and an assessment area. A beach-inspired spa offers sauna and steam rooms, salt relaxation, cold plunge pools and private treatment rooms. Infinity pools, landscaped podium gardens, a volleyball court, a padel court, a co-working lounge, a cinema, a kids' room, a tween room, a kids' plaza, a residential lounge, a grab and go bar and a private dining space with a social kitchen complete the offer.

Interiors are bright and calm, with abundant natural light, sea views and a soothing coastal palette. Every space opens to light and breeze, while generous balconies extend living areas outdoors. Kitchens are by Italian brands and walk-in wardrobes add storage and comfort. Residents enjoy round-the-clock concierge, valet service and direct beach access, along with wellness concierge services, personal training and community sports clubs. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens and appliances, leaving furniture to the owner's own taste.

##### Location description and benefits

Fahid Island is the first island in the UAE designed with well-being as its foundation, set along the coast of Abu Dhabi between Yas Island and Saadiyat Island. Landscaped parks, restorative gardens, green trails and protected native ecosystems cover much of the island, alongside a long coastline of beaches, a marina, a waterfront promenade and the Coral Drive shopping boulevard.

King's College School Wimbledon, a wellness clinic, Flora Mall, Heritage Park, a five-star beach resort, an event plaza and a beach club and watersports hub are planned across the island. Yas Island is a short drive away, while Saadiyat Island, Zayed International Airport and the centre of Abu Dhabi are within easy reach, and Dubai is within comfortable driving distance for weekend trips.

Fahid Island is an investment zone open to international buyers and one of the most distinctive wellness-led destinations in the region. Beachfront apartments designed by a renowned architect and set close to Yas Island and Saadiyat Island are in limited supply. Strong demand from families, professionals and holiday home buyers supports long-term value and attractive rental prospects for owners and investors.
